subject: Portal snapshot transfer & evidence QA — BlueCove Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: BlueCove Security Team <security@bluecovehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Portal snapshot transfer & evidence QA — BlueCove Health

Hi Daniel / BlueCove security team,

Thanks again for the quick sync this week. As discussed, we're preparing a snapshot export of the vendor portal profile and the current evidence bundle so you can ingest into your OneTrust instance for the procurement review. Quick summary of what's included and requests: 

- What we're sending: a curated snapshot (index + file refs) of the Vendr/OneTrust profile for the Redwood account, plus the evidence index (SOC 2 bridges, encrypted S3 manifests).
- Timeline: we can stage the snapshot Friday (07/23) between 10:00–13:00 PT. Please confirm a preferred 1-hour window for the S3 transfer.
- Needs from you: a target S3 endpoint/bucket (or OneTrust ingest link), and confirmation of the CAIQ/SIG field mapping you want us to prioritize. If you have a template or mapping spreadsheet, attach it and we'll align.
- Retention/handback: our default is 30 days in the staging bucket before automatic purge; we can extend if you need longer retention for validation.

Attachments: portal_snapshot_manifest.csv (summary of files); evidence_index_v1.xlsx (high-level index). Transfer instructions are attached in transfer_instructions.txt.

Next steps: can you confirm the transfer window and the S3 destination? Also please let us know if BlueCove needs any additional attestation (hashes, checksums, POA).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Security Integrations — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: portal_snapshot_manifest.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: evidence_index_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: transfer_instructions.txt (txt)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecovehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 12:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot transfer & evidence QA — BlueCove Health

Marcus – thanks for the clear summary. We can take the snapshot on Friday; preferred slot is 11:00–12:00 PT. Our infra team will create a presigned S3 put endpoint for the bucket bc-ot-ingest-2027 and will send credentials via our secure portal (we won't share creds over email).

Two quick asks from our side before transfer:
1) Can you include a simple mapping sheet that aligns your SIG/CAIQ question IDs to our OneTrust question IDs? That will speed ingestion and reduce manual rework.
2) Retention: 30 days is fine, but please include a short log of checksums (SHA256) per file in the manifest so our validation process can auto-verify integrity.

I'll loop in our infra contact if needed. We also noted a small procurement requirement: if there are any redline items in the SOC 2 bridge (policy wording), flag them in the index so our GRC reviewer can triage.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Security Operations — BlueCove Health
security@bluecovehealth.com
[Attachment: None]

On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 09:13 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Daniel / BlueCove security team,
> 
> Thanks again for the quick sync this week. As discussed, we're preparing a snapshot export...

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecovehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot transfer & evidence QA — BlueCove Health

Daniel — thanks, 11:00–12:00 PT on Friday works. Quick clarifications and actions from our side:

- Mapping sheet: attached (evidence_mapping_for_bluecove.xlsx). It maps Redwood SIG IDs -> CAIQ question IDs -> OneTrust question ID placeholders. Note the mapping is best-effort for custom fields; flag any mismatches and we'll iterate.
- Checksums: we'll append a checksums.csv (SHA256) to the manifest and include file-level size and last-modified timestamps.
- Redlines/bridges: in evidence_index_v1.xlsx we've included a "notes" column where items that are policy-different are flagged with TL;DR and suggested text.
- Technical handoff: transfer_instructions.txt contains the presigned-put manifest format and recommended multipart chunk size. S3 staging path: s3://redwood-portal-staging/bluecove/2027-07-23/.

Please confirm the ingest account (we'll wait for the presigned links). If you'd like, Irene can run a quick validation script post-transfer to return a verification report.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security Program Manager — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: evidence_mapping_for_bluecove.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: checksums.csv (csv)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecovehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot transfer & evidence QA — BlueCove Health

Mina / Marcus — transfer completed and ingest finished on our side. Quick notes: 

- Ingest: we pulled from s3://redwood-portal-staging/bluecove/2027-07-23/ using the presigned put objects; integrity checks passed for 98% of files. We had 4 small metadata files fail checksum (likely CRLF vs LF mismatch). Our team normalized and re-ingested; can you confirm if you prefer we leave the normalized copies or request you re-upload with original line endings?
- Mapping: the OneTrust question IDs matched for 92% of mapped items. A handful of custom CAIQ fields (column CAIQ-CUST-12) didn't have a clear target; we've created a temporary placeholder in OneTrust and submitted a ticket to our GRC queue (HS-67214) tagging your team.
- DocuSign: procurement needs the transfer attestation signed; I've initiated a DocuSign envelope (link below) for Marcus to sign (standard transfer & handling attestation).

Next steps: Marcus, could you sign the DocuSign? Irene, if you can run the validation script and confirm the source checksums vs our normalized set, that will close the loop. We'll keep the staging bucket data for 30 days per the retention agreement.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Security Operations — BlueCove Health
security@bluecovehealth.com
[DocuSign: https://docusign.net/BC-4895/transfer-agreement]
